ARMELANG 1: First Year first quarter Armenian is the first course in a three quarter sequence. The course emphasizes developing basic level communication skills using daily life topics and cultural life in Armenia. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational modes of communication. Armenian culture.
ARMELANG 2: First-Year Armenian, Second Quarter. Course emphasizes developing basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication.
ARMELANG 3: Course emphasizes developing basic level communication skills using daily life topics. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive and presentational modes of communication. Completion of this course fulfills the University language requirement.
ARMELANG 21: Continuation of Armelang 3. Expands students' proficiency in Armenian language and culture at intermediate level through various texts and multimedia. Students will continue to learn the language with an emphasis on communicative and interactive classroom activities. Prerequisite: Placement Test, or Armelang 3
